storyboard: 1915: Gandhiji returns to India and introduces Satyagraha.
1928-29: Simon Commission boycott & Purna Swaraj declaration.
1930-34: Dandi Salt March & Civil Disobedience Movement.
summary: Traces the growth of anti-colonial national movement led by Mahatma Gandhi, examining diverse social participation and cultural symbols.
key_takeaways: Satyagraha emphasized non-violent soul-force based on truth.
Non-Cooperation united Hindus and Muslims via Khilafat issue.
Civil Disobedience launched with Dandi Salt March against salt monopoly.
Cultural symbols like Bharat Mata and Swaraj flag fostered collective identity.
